note: All cases are synthetic. They exercise resampling behaviour only and support no biological interpretation.

cases.name: constant-field
cases.description: Uniform intensity 12.5 on 16x16. Resampling any grid must return 12.5 exactly with coverage 1 where a cell is fully inside the source.

cases.name: known-integral-spot
cases.description: Discrete Gaussian spot on 32x32 centered at (15.5,15.5), sigma=3.5, peak 1000. Sum mode at 64x64 must reproduce the discrete total.

cases.name: partial-mask
cases.description: Ramp 0..100 over 24x24 with an invalid circular hole and a masked-out corner. Coverage must be reported per cell; missing cells are NaN.

cases.name: extreme-dynamic-range
cases.description: Field spanning 1e-12 to 1e6, including exact zeros and a few NaN pixels. Tests that no FLOAT32 conversion happens before statistics.

cases.name: zero-vs-missing
cases.description: Left half is real zeros, right half is masked non-zero values. A cell spanning both must average to 0 (real zero), coverage 0.5, not 0.5*value.

cases.name: float32-tiff
cases.description: Same spot field saved as uncompressed float32 TIFF for testing TIFF loading. Values are quantized to float32, which is recorded as a known precision limit.
